featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NHD-500-DNT-TX is part of the powerful NetworkHD 500 series family of products. Capable of encoding up to 4K60 including Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG content. The 500 series comes loaded with a number of advanced features such as the flexibility of Ethernet or Fiber as a transport method. Ultra-low latency encoding and incredibly fast matrix switching speeds enhance the experience. Unique to this encoder is an integrated 2 channel Dante & AES67 audio output.

The integrated 2 channel Dante & AES67 output allows audio to be sent over the network to compatible Dante & AES67 enabled DSPs, amplifiers, mixers and more. Audio can be transmitted via Dante from either the encoder’s HDMI input or a separate analog input.

Dante audio and NetworkHD A/V can be integrated into the same network or separated via a dedicated Dante-only port. If 3rd-party Dante equipment exists on a dedicated network, simply connect the Dante-only port to keep things separate and avoid complicated network configurations.

Less than a single frame a latency (16ms) when in passthrough mode allows content to be distributed without any perceivable delay.
